A beautiful question!

To extract just the text from the `<strong>` tag, you can use the `.text` property in BeautifulSoup. Here's how:

```
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup

# assume 'soup' is your BeautifulSoup object
tag = soup.find('strong')
text = tag.text.strip()

print(text)  # prints "Too many login attempts. Please try again in 50 seconds."
```

The `.strip()` method is used to remove any extra whitespace from the text.

Alternatively, you can use a more explicit approach with `tag.get_text()`, which also strips whitespace:

```
text = tag.get_text()
print(text)  # prints "Too many login attempts. Please try again in 50 seconds."
```
